name: Elimination and Rank
description: Solve systems by elimination and count how many independent directions a matrix keeps.

lessonNames.l1-one-pivot-at-a-time: Elimination, one pivot at a time
lessonNames.l9-area-scale: The determinant as an area scale

lessonObjectives.l1-one-pivot-at-a-time: Reduce a system to triangular form by elimination.
lessonObjectives.l2-back-substitution: Solve a triangular system from the bottom up.
lessonObjectives.l3-factorisation: Record the elimination steps as $A = LU$.
lessonObjectives.l4-zero-pivot: Swap rows when a pivot is zero, and spot when elimination breaks down.
lessonObjectives.l5-everything-reachable: Describe the column space of a matrix.
lessonObjectives.l6-inputs-to-zero: Find the nullspace from the free variables.
lessonObjectives.l7-bases: Test vectors for independence and choose a basis.
lessonObjectives.l8-real-directions: Find the rank and use it to count the solutions of a system.
lessonObjectives.l9-area-scale: Read a determinant as the factor by which a matrix scales area.
lessonObjectives.l10-computing-dets: Compute determinants by cofactors and by elimination.
lessonObjectives.l11-squashed: Link a zero determinant to a singular matrix and dependent columns.
lessonObjectives.l12-redundant-assets: Detect a redundant asset in a payoff matrix from its rank.
